==About==

A {{i|Blueback Tuna}} can be dried on a {{i|Drying Frame}} for 72 hours to make a {{i|Dried Blueback Tuna}}. Due to the current nature of the most recent Fish rework there is no reason to ever make a Dried Blueback Tuna.
